messages:
Anya V.: kicking off a config-only rollout: cfg-20260321-29. goal: cut per-token cost by nudging batching + routing. changes: batching.window_ms 10 -> 4, max_batch_size 64 -> 96, default_timeout 20s -> 14s, routing.policy default -> cost-aware-preempt. small canary 2% for 12m. deploy-bot will handle.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Canary started for cfg-20260321-29 on serving-configs. Targets: canary pool (4 hosts), percent=2%. Watchlist: p95/p99, kvcache_hit_rate, abort_rate, tenant_error_groups. Link: https://dash/redeploy/cfg-20260321-29

Ravi K.: noted. adding queries for kvcache heatmap + rejected-by-timeout counts.

Sam (Platform): cost-aware routing will shift some traffic off hot hosts; expect different host-level metrics. pin model-variant to stable-v2 for this canary.

ops-oncall: i'll shadow alerts. page if abort_rate > 0.4% or p99 > 15% over baseline.

deploy-bot: canary at 2% after 6m: p95 +1.5%, p99 +9%, abort_rate 0.18%, kvcache_hit_rate -6% vs baseline. no pages yet. :white_check_mark:

Nina (SRE): kvcache drop stands out. higher max_batch_size + smaller window could reduce intra-host prefix sharing. which tenants show biggest delta?

Ravi K.: looking: enterprise-legacy tenant shows p99 +28% and aborts up. consumer-light tenants ok. correlates with longer concat prompts.

Anya V.: interesting. proposal: soft-pin enterprise-legacy to pre-change routing and keep change for others, then iterate. we can do partial-scope rollback for that tenant only. thoughts?

Sam (Platform): partial rollback for one tenant is supported via tenant-routing overrides. we can flip enterprise-legacy to legacy-routing and set max_batch_size=64 for them. that'll be quick.

ops-oncall: agree. avoid full rollback if we can mitigate quickly. do it now and wait 6m for signal.

deploy-bot: Applying tenant override: enterprise-legacy -> legacy-routing + max_batch_size=64. Rolling change to canary slice.

deploy-bot: tenant override applied. Metrics snapshot (3m): enterprise-legacy p99 back within 3% of baseline, aborts down. other tenants unaffected.

Nina (SRE): good recovery. still want an RCA because kvcache hit rate dropped overall. suspect batching.window reduction killed cross-request prefix coalescing.

Anya V.: decision: do not rollback globally. keep cfg-20260321-29 for non-sensitive tenants. action items: 1) create per-tenant safe-list and gating (FR-1301), 2) add a preflight that simulates long-chained prompts for high-risk tenants (TEST-455), 3) tweak default max_batch_size back to 80 while we run A/B.

Ravi K.: i'll file FR-1301 and TEST-455, and update dashboard to show per-tenant kvcache heatmap + timeout aborts.

Sam (Platform): i'll draft release-note: "CONFIG-20260321-29: adjusted batching and routing to reduce unit cost. Partial tenant override applied for enterprise-legacy due to increased tail latency; no global rollback. Next steps: per-tenant gating and preflight tests. See FR-1301, TEST-455."

ops-oncall: mark this as monitored; no pager since mitigation succeeded. schedule a full rollout to 20% in low-traffic change window (weekend) after FR-1301 lands.

Anya V.: thanks everyone. nice middle ground — prevented full rollback and drove concrete follow-ups. :thumbsup:
